headline: Record revenue and margin expansion drive a swing to profit
summary_short: Coherent's fiscal Q4 2026 revenue rose 33.8% y/y and 13.3% q/q to $2.05B, with non-GAAP diluted EPS of $1.74 up 74% y/y as GAAP net earnings swung to $240.5M from a $95.6M loss a year ago.
summary_long: Revenue reached a record $2.05B (+33.8% y/y, +13.3% q/q) as Datacenter & Communications revenue grew to $1,615.0M on AI-driven optical-connectivity demand, while Industrial revenue fell to $430.5M. Non-GAAP gross margin expanded to 40.2% (+215bps y/y) and non-GAAP operating income rose 62.1% y/y to $445.8M; non-GAAP diluted EPS of $1.74 grew $0.74 y/y. GAAP net earnings swung to $240.5M from a $95.6M loss, aided by lower restructuring/impairment charges and a $38.4M gain on sale of an equity investment. For Q1 FY2027 the company guided revenue to $2.2B-$2.4B, non-GAAP gross margin to 39.5%-41.5%, and non-GAAP EPS to $1.85-$2.05. Cash fell to $1.16B q/q on short-term-investment purchases and capex, while equity nearly doubled y/y to $10.90B on the preferred-to-common conversion.

drivers.explanation: CEO cited AI datacenter architectures shifting from copper to optical connectivity as the primary growth driver; Datacenter & Communications revenue rose to $1,615.0M while Industrial revenue fell to $430.5M.
CFO attributed the margin gain to strong operational execution converting top-line growth into profit; the release does not break out per-segment or per-cost-line drivers for the margin expansion.
Operating income grew faster than revenue as gross margin expanded and non-GAAP opex fell to about 18.4% of revenue from 20.1% y/y, per the release's own reconciliation tables.

Lower restructuring charges ($6.1M vs $53.9M) and impairments ($44.3M vs $85.0M) y/y, plus a $38.4M gain on sale of an equity investment, added to the revenue and margin gains in swinging GAAP net earnings from a $95.6M loss to a $240.5M profit.
Diluted EPS rose with the higher net earnings above, though partly diluted by a higher weighted-average share count (202.2M vs 155.5M y/y) tied to the Series B preferred-to-common conversion.
The CEO noted full-year non-GAAP EPS grew more than twice the rate of revenue growth; Q4 non-GAAP EPS also outgrew revenue this quarter on the margin expansion and opex leverage described above.

The release discloses only annual cash flows; FY2026 investing activities included $1,025.0M of short-term-investment purchases and $1,102.9M of capex, consistent with cash being deployed even as operations stayed cash-generative.
Long-term debt fell 12.6% y/y as $1,723.4M of debt was repaid during FY2026, partly offset by $1,250.0M of new Term A Facility borrowings tied to the year's capital-structure changes.

Equity nearly doubled y/y, consistent with $1,998.6M of common-share issuance during FY2026 and the conversion of Series B Redeemable Preferred Stock to common equity shown in the EPS reconciliation tables.
CEO called fiscal 2026 an outstanding year with record revenue and non-GAAP EPS growth outpacing revenue growth, entering fiscal 2027 with strong AI-driven demand and expanding production capacity.
